g.text: No autonomous 3V3 OV or final BMS/RBF hardware is implied. Custom-field S11 presentation remains API-limited.

g.desc: No autonomous 3V3 OV or final BMS/RBF hardware is implied. Custom-field S11 presentation remains API-limited.

g.text: SYS flag now models real passive PowerPath output; BOOST flag = internal diode + SW bootstrap energy.

g.desc: SYS flag now models real passive PowerPath output; BOOST flag = internal diode + SW bootstrap energy.

g.text: Input MPPT/weak-solar loop, shared startup, minimum effective C/L, hot SOA and sensor limits remain open.

g.desc: Input MPPT/weak-solar loop, shared startup, minimum effective C/L, hot SOA and sensor limits remain open.

g.text: No raw BMS VSS joins system GND. Pack thermistor is separate Semitec103AT-2; no dummy/bypass.

g.desc: No raw BMS VSS joins system GND. Pack thermistor is separate Semitec103AT-2; no dummy/bypass.

g.text: BATT_PERMITTED = future protected + interlocked 2S source fixture; all Kelvin sensing stays after RBF.

g.desc: BATT_PERMITTED = future protected + interlocked 2S source fixture; all Kelvin sensing stays after RBF.
